story.title: Built for the way you actually train
paragraphs: QVFITS makes premium seamless and seam-fit activewear, swim and lounge wear, from a showroom at THE CUBE in Kisementi. Seamless where you want no seams to rub, seam-fit where you want structure: the construction is chosen per piece, not per season.

We keep the range tight on purpose. Every piece is worn and tested before it goes in, which is why we can tell you honestly when something runs small, and why we would rather move you to a different piece than sell you the wrong size.

items.title: Chosen, not bulk-ordered
items.text: Small drops per colourway. If you see it in the studio, only a handful of people in Kampala will be training in it.

items.title: Honest about fit
items.text: Every piece carries a real fit note: runs small, cut relaxed, true to size. We would rather you order once.

items.title: Styled, not just sold
items.text: Tell us what you train in and we'll have pieces waiting. Come and move in them before you buy.

items.title: Delivered across Uganda
items.text: Kampala and upcountry, or collect from the showroom. Free delivery over {freeShipping}.

sizeGuide.title: Size guide
sizeGuide.lede: These are body measurements, not garment measurements. Measure yourself over your underwear, keep the tape snug but not tight, and breathe normally.

measures.name: Bust
measures.text: around the fullest part, tape level at the back.

measures.name: Waist
measures.text: the narrowest point, usually just above the belly button.

measures.name: Hips
measures.text: the fullest part, around 20 cm below your waist.

contact.title: Come see us, or just ask
